records.notes: Cohort is defined as franchisee-owned locations meeting four criteria: open at least 1 year as of 12/31/2025, in a market of at least 1 million people, operating for the full 12 months of 2025, and operating from a dedicated retail showroom staffed full time. Of the six total franchisee-owned locations, five met these criteria. Data is unaudited.
